title: [DocDB] FlushJobTest unit test fails in tsan runs.
body:
Jira Link: [DB-3359](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3359)
### Description

Data from the test run [stability](https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/stability?num_commits=25): 

Number | Test | Fail % | Number of recent failures | Commit Fail % | Number of failed commits
